Laura / Marissa — forwarding a request from Stellar (related deal SD-7831). Summary: procurement delay + security review means they need more runway to complete the integration. They asked for 250k free tokens and a 30-day extension. They will sign an addendum and provide a PO once procurement clears.

Why I’m asking for exception: Stellar is a high-propensity midmarket deal (pilot showing >5k ARR MRR potential if model quality holds). The engineering team is blocked on residency checks; losing momentum now would likely push the sale out of this quarter. Our standard PLG limit is 75k tokens / 14 days; this request is well beyond that.

Proposed one-off concessions (my recommendation):
- Grant 200,000 free token-equivalents (one-off)
- Approve a 21-day POC extension (instead of 30) to limit exposure
- Allow a temporary billing hold until we receive PO (max 45 days)
- Legal to author a simple addendum: term-limited credit + PO clause

If you approve, I’ll get Legal to draft the addendum, send DocuSign, and coordinate the PO flow with procurement@stellardata.com. If you want to be conservative, we can reduce to 150k tokens and 14d extension.

Attachments: procurement-timeline.xlsx (from customer)

Thanks — Rishi
